_what: Ceilings that may only ever go DOWN. Raising one is allowed exactly once per deliberate decision, in its own commit, with the reason in the message.
_measured_at: 2026-09-18: 7496 -> 7502, deliberately and once, hours after the previous raise and for the half it missed. 2026.38 gave the retry ladder a budget and ended the standing order when the budget refused — but only at the ladder. _tryHealStation asks the same question one guard earlier and answered it with a bare return, and THAT is the branch the default configuration takes: address healing is on out of the box, so a listener who unticks the retry switch never reaches the ladder. The order stayed up with no timer under it and the next reachability edge handed a long-dead station to netResumeTimer — issue #13 verbatim, under the setting offered as its cure. The teardown now lives in one _orderSpent() that both refusals call, which is the same medicine _mayKnock was for the switch. Ceiling = wc -l package/contents/ui/main.qml | FullRepresentation.qml 6863 -> 6874, 2026-09-19, for two defects that only appeared once the widget was driven for real. Starring a web result called remove() in the middle of the delegate's own function, which destroys that delegate: every name after it resolved in a dead scope, so the result cap never shrank and "Show more" could retire over a page the directory still had more of. The three references are now held before the removal. And the minute dials stepped by five while stopping at 59, so one press down from :00 gave :59 and the dial then walked 54, 49, 44 with no way back to a round minute; all three now stop at 55. The lines are the captures and the two explanations. | main.qml 7502 -> 7510, 2026-09-19, for two defects a hunt found and a refuter could not talk down. Podcast speed applied and was never saved: the prune's new object was assigned to a readonly binding, which threw and took the config write on the next line with it. And the tab guard never ran at startup (a view that starts at 0 emits no change) and watched three of the five tab switches, so someone who hid the Stations tab was handed it every login. Three of the lines are the missing handlers and the missing call; the rest is why.
_how_to_remeasure: direct_exec:      grep -rhoE 'executable\.exec\(' package --include='*.qml' | wc -l   (then subtract the facade's own body — tests/test_ratchet.py does that part)
